source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Falling Back does not stop the bearer's unit from shooting or declaring a charge later that turn, and **Desperate Escape tests** for its models may be re-rolled. Only a **RAVENWING** model may take it.

effects.appliesTo: Desperate Escape tests for models in the bearer's unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Lion’s Blade Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
